# Pinned G# linter

The three source/project files in this directory are copied without changes from
`tools/Goo.Gslint` in [obselate/goo](https://github.com/obselate/goo/tree/a1ac980886757b8733d0fdb9e996994dd1217f0b/tools/Goo.Gslint),
commit `a1ac980886757b8733d0fdb9e996994dd1217f0b`.
The included MIT license is from the same repository and revision.
The formatter derives from the MIT-licensed G# formatter by GSharp Authors.

This is build tooling only. It does not ship in the widget package.
Its parser dependency is the published `Gsharp.NET.Sdk` 0.4.1 package.
